results.title: Kurī
results.overview: Kurī hasn't been back home to Te Urewera since she was bitten on the face by a dog as a child. She must return home and face the uncertainty of grief - whether she's ready to or not.

results.title: Playtime
results.overview: Brazil from the perspective of school pupils aged 14 to 19. Combining a documentary with a fictional approach, Hora do recreio addresses topics including violence, racism and drug dealing.

results.title: Greg Larsen: Where's My Fucken Money?
results.original_title: Greg Larsen: Where's My Fucken Money?
results.overview: Greg Larsen's new feature length comedy special from Humdinger Studios. Come with him as he discovers where his fucken money is!

results.title: The Last Patient
results.overview: On the eve of her retirement, Judith, a suburban doctor, opens her practice door to Aïda — eight months pregnant and having fallen out of the medical care system. Confronted with a healthcare system pushed to the breaking point, Judith agrees to take the young woman in, embarking on a night that will put all her convictions as a healthcare professional to the test.

results.title: Last Night
results.overview: Strangers Arun and Tam meet on a rooftop the night they both intend to end their lives. When Arun suggests they spend the night together instead, just until sunrise, they embark on an unexpected journey through the city.

results.title: It Wants Nightmares
results.overview: It Wants Nightmares unfurls as a dark journey through the haunted landscape of the American South, where Adelaide, tough but broken by her past, finds herself entangled in a web of sinister events and supernatural dread.

results.title: Vera
results.overview: Vera Alexandrovna is 80 years old. She lives alone in her apartment. Нer only company comes from her caretaker, Irina, and her son, Kirill.  Her days have long become monotonous: there is no room for chance, and everything happens according to her plan, exactly as she wants it.  Old age is unacceptable to her; to acknowledge it would mean accepting dependence, vulnerability, and the loss of control over her own life.  On a typical day, she takes a shower, reads a book, and visits her son. But this morning, a light bulb burns out — and nothing will ever be the same again.  Her son Kirill is apathetic and withdrawn: he fears her, resents her, and yet reveres her, making their relationship both dependent and destructive. This unresolved tension culminates in a desperate act.

results.title: Greetings From Samson
results.overview: Samson, a young and ambitious proofreader at a greeting card company, follows his dream of becoming a greeting card writer and learns that sometimes the hardest part is just showing up. Also, he’s a hot dog!

results.title: Happy
results.overview: During a boring visit to her grandmother's house, Cárol discovers a unique doll to kill time with. But she soon realizes that, in that house, she isn't the only one who knows how to have fun.

results.title: Camp Duval
results.overview: Welcome to Camp Duval, the wildest comedy camp ever created — where rising comics come to sharpen their jokes, survive the chaos, and hopefully make it through the night.

results.title: Full Tank
results.overview: A getaway driver must wait three minutes for a gang of burglars to return to his car before making their escape. There’s just one problem... he’s absolutely desperate for a piss.

results.title: Another Man's Wife
results.overview: A millionaire makes a shocking offer to a married couple in crisis, who are financially devastated and caring for a terminally ill parent. What begins as an act of survival spirals into a high-stakes emotional reckoning about trust, love and the ultimate cost of sacrifice.

results.title: Завтра
results.overview: Pavel is mired in debt and in desperate need of money. His creditors are determined to collect what is owed—at any cost and as soon as possible. Driven by desperation, Pavel decides to take a risk; borrowing his wife’s car under the pretext of celebrating his son’s birthday, he seizes a final chance to make some easy money.

results.title: Nobody Knows the World
results.overview: In the outskirts of Lima, eleven-year-old Chito cares for the carrier pigeons used in his brother’s drug trade. After violence shatters his childhood, grief and a fragile gesture of humanity open the possibility of another destiny.

results.title: Piring
results.overview: A blindfold over the eyes will guide the transition each situations -- from the past, present, and future. Through this, Jade will be revealed as a womanizer and a deceiver, but behind his deceptive heart dwells a child longing for care and a victim of violence.

results.title: Rapinoe
results.overview: Soccer star Megan Rapinoe explores what it means to win and lose in this intimate portrait.

results.title: Our Lost Thing
results.overview: A daughter searches for a film script, driven by her father's last words: "I can't die because I didn't make a movie." The film is the incomplete and obscured unfolding of that man, that mystery: an unusual family man, with a variety of jobs and no success, who uses a camera like an obsessive, someone who lives his life observing others.

results.title: Mission
results.overview: Alienated Dylan throws off the shackles of his solitary life in an attempt to experience the highs and lows of existence at its most extreme, embarking on a thrilling journey of self-discovery that proves both inspiring and terrifying.
